newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bonds raise record $4.3 bln in June - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bonds raise record $4.3 bln in June - paper.

text.p: Brazil has raised $8.286 billion so far this year, including a record $4.294 billion in June, via the issue overseas of bonds and commercial paper, O Globo newspaper reported.
Citing figures from the National Association of Investment Banks (ANBID), Globo said the amount should reach $20 billion by year's end compared with $19.1 billion in 1996.

The paper said the June figure included $1 billion raised by the federal government and the rest by banks and companies. It did not give comparative figures for June 1996 or the first half of last year.

But the numbers show foreign investor confidence in Brazil is strong while increasing numbers of Brazilian firms are looking to raise funds abroad because of the longer maturities and lower interest rates, it said.
